name: Database Foothold to Privilege Escalation
description: Publicly exposed database combined with elevated sudo rights on database service account

findings.title: PostgreSQL database exposed on all interfaces
findings.why_it_matters: Allows unauthenticated network connections to internal database service
findings.remediation_hint: Bind postgres to 127.0.0.1 or firewall port 5432

findings.title: Postgres service user has full sudo privileges
findings.why_it_matters: PostgreSQL compromise directly leads to root escalation
findings.remediation_hint: Revoke sudo permissions from postgres system account

findings.title: Deleted executable running from memory
findings.why_it_matters: Indicates execution of an unlinked or stealth binary

expected_clusters.hypothesis: Exposed database service combined with sudo access for postgres user enables external foothold to root compromise
